title: Freeze CCP2 observation and fixed-PHY policy cases
description:
Scope: independent CCP2 observation/policy fixtures in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Specify unchanged receiver channel/profile at densities 0, 9, 10, 11 and 50 while retaining the adopted adaptive-duty tiers. Cover direct-peer deduplication, relayed origins, idle-many/busy-few, weak RSSI without synthetic peers, directional versus reverse SNR, stale/unknown coverage, off-channel/sleep gaps and observations during suppressed traffic. Produce explicit tables rather than production estimator output. No new adaptation controller or sensitivity rule is introduced.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Preserve existing control-density and airtime tiers without reviving density-driven CH0/SF decisions. Use bounded input histories and explicit expected observations, not another production estimator implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Independent expected tables keep profile 0x01 at SF10 and receiver home stable across congestion/density changes. Directly observed peers, busy time, local airtime, CCA deferrals and directional delivery evidence remain separate metrics. Reverse-link SNR and unattributed timeout cannot become receiving-end sensitivity evidence; unknown coverage remains unknown. TX completion and CCA-clear never supply delivery or missing-ACK loss estimates. All cases have strict schema and requirement references.
